slides.title: What *happened*
slides.body: Anthropic filed an S-1 with the SEC on Oct 26. It wants to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT.

slides.title: What is *not* set
slides.body: No share price, no share count and no IPO date yet. 22 banks are on the deal, led by Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley.

slides.title: Still *no ads*
slides.body: The filing shows money from subscriptions and usage, with no ad business. Anthropic pledged in February that Claude stays ad free.

slides.title: What it means *for you*
slides.body: Nothing changes in your Claude today. The free plan still works, and it can already do real work for you, like finding subscriptions you forgot.
